data.company_overview: Postman is an AI-native API platform that enables developers to develop, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services, offering tools for both individual engineers and enterprise-scale organizations.
data.target_audience: Software engineers, developers, and enterprise teams that design, build, test, and maintain APIs.

data.company_overview: Supabase provides a Postgres‑based development platform that delivers a full database, authentication, edge functions, storage, realtime sync, vector search, and instant REST APIs as a unified backend.
data.target_audience: Developers and product teams building web, mobile, or AI‑powered applications who need scalable, managed PostgreSQL infrastructure and integrated backend services.

data.company_overview: Vapi provides a platform for building, deploying, and managing advanced voice AI agents that can handle customer support, lead qualification, and appointment scheduling. The solution offers enterprise‑grade features such as real‑time monitoring, SSO/OAuth, compliance certifications, and scalable infrastructure.
data.target_audience: Enterprises and large organizations that need voice‑based AI agents for customer support, sales, and other high‑volume call interactions.
